label: Events
description: Registers DOM event listeners with optional command dispatch and removes the registered listeners on disposal.

on.description: Registers a listener for one or more DOM event names on an element. When listener is a string, creates a callback that passes that command to the handler supplied to the Events constructor. Registrations are tracked for later disposal.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: DOM EventTarget-like element supporting addEventListener and removeEventListener.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: A single event name or an iterable collection of event names.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.description: An event listener function, or a command string dispatched to the constructor-supplied handler.

returns.description: Undefined; listeners are registered for subsequent removal by dispose().
